python3 - <<'PY'
p='scripts/summarize-automatic-pilot.mjs'
s=open(p).read().replace('for (const match of matches) calls.push(', 'for (const [index, match] of matches.entries()) calls.push(').replace('help:/--help\\b/.test(item.command)', 'help:/--help\\b/.test(item.command.slice(match.index, matches[index + 1]?.index))')

node scripts/summarize-automatic-pilot.mjs > /tmp/dip-pilot-summary-live.json
node --input-type=module - <<'NODE'
import fs from 'node:fs';const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/dip-pilot-summary-live.json'));console.log(JSON.stringify({started:r.turnsStarted,finished:r.finishedAt,arms:r.arms}));
